name: Aira
summary: AI-assisted B2B prospecting on a Europe-native company database, with meeting notes flowing into records automatically. The product is young and independent review coverage is thin, so test it against a concrete metric of your own.
best_for: European B2B sales teams that want AI-assisted prospecting and automatic meeting/CRM hygiene from a Europe-native database
skip_if: your market is primarily US/global (US-native databases cover it better), or you need a mature, battle-tested platform today
honest_knock: Young product, sharp focus: European B2B prospecting on a 65-million-company database with meeting notes flowing into records automatically. The honest checks: independent review coverage is still thin, so run your own two-week test against a concrete metric (meetings booked, admin hours saved) rather than trusting early-adopter buzz. And note that the money-back guarantee exists precisely so you can do that without risk.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per user a month, billed monthly
pricing.notes: (read 2026-08-26 on aira.app/pricing) Aira is €149 per user a month, billed monthly, for the company database, AI prospecting, monitoring and on-demand research. Aira Connect starts at €499 a month, billed annually, and adds CRM enrichment and live signals on the accounts already in HubSpot, Salesforce or Pipedrive. These are euro prices for everyone: we read the page from a US connection and got the same euro figures, which fits a product that describes itself as the intelligence layer for European dealmaking across 14 markets.
